parameters.name: n_ref
parameters.description: total human population (UN World Population Prospects 2019)

parameters.name: m_ref
parameters.description: total mosquito population (assumed twice the human population)

parameters.name: beta1
parameters.description: mosquito-to-human transmission, per-capita form (= beta1_paper * m_ref)

parameters.name: beta2
parameters.description: human-to-mosquito transmission, per-capita form (= beta2_paper * n_ref)

parameters.name: phi
parameters.description: proportion of infections that become symptomatic (Johansson 2014)

parameters.name: omega
parameters.description: YF-induced death rate among symptomatic humans

parameters.name: lambda1
parameters.description: rate of symptom onset after infection (1/intrinsic incubation period)

parameters.name: lambda2
parameters.description: rate of viraemic onset in mosquitoes (1/extrinsic incubation period)

parameters.name: gamma
parameters.description: rate of viraemia completion in humans (recovery)

parameters.name: delta
parameters.description: mosquito development (recruitment) rate from hatching to adult

parameters.name: immune
parameters.description: proportion of the human population immune at outbreak start (natural + vaccine-acquired; paper's baseline is 0.80)

parameters.name: y0
parameters.description: initial exposed mosquitoes (fitted by the paper; its value 150)

parameters.name: z0
parameters.description: initial infectious mosquitoes (fitted by the paper; its value 995)
